about_the_game:
Drift, Deliver, Survive.

The world as we knew it is gone. A cataclysmic interdimensional shift shattered reality, tearing open portals to unknown worlds. Through these rifts came horrors beyond imagination. But even in the apocalypse, people need their packages, and you're one of the few drivers willing to deliver.
Armed with high-speed drift machines, heavy firepower, and pure skill, you’ll need to slide, swerve, and shoot your way through the chaos to complete your missions.

This isn’t just about speed. It’s about style, precision, and survival.

But deliveries are just treating the symptoms. As you navigate this hostile world, you’ll uncover clues about the interdimensional catastrophe, gathering intel and experimental technology in pursuit of the ultimate goal...finding a way to permanently eradicate the monsters and close the portals for good.

Key Features:

🔥 Drift or Die – Master fast-paced drifting mechanics to maintain speed, escape danger, squash hordes of monsters, and navigate the broken streets.

🛠 Customize & Upgrade – Tune your car with adjustable suspension, turbo boosts, custom exhausts, wide-body kits, neon underglow, and liveries. Modify a variety of fictional vehicles, each with unique handling and combat potential.

🔫Weaponized Rides – Mount roof turrets, front-mounted machine guns, rear projectile launchers, EMP cannons, drift busters, and more to clear your path. Customize your loadout to handle different monster threats.

🔑 Unlock – Discover new cars, powerful upgrades, and devastating weapons to enhance your drifting and combat abilities. Hunt for lost packages scattered across the city to find rare blueprints and unlock even more possibilities.

🧟Survive the Hordes – Battle against swarms of grotesque mutants and hulking monstrosities, each with its own deadly behavior. Some chase you down, others ambush from the shadows, some dash at breakneck speeds, while others explode or leach onto your car. Every monster will tear through entire city blocks just to get to you. Stay sharp, or become the hunted.

📦 High-Risk Deliveries – Speed through monster-infested streets to deliver vital supplies. The more dangerous the mission, the bigger the payout.

🦸‍♂️ Numerous Monster Species – Over 100 species have already been identified, ranging from tiny, nimble creatures to towering, building-sized kaiju. And with portals opening every day, more terrifying creatures are constantly pouring in. Adapt your strategy as new threats emerge from the interdimensional rifts!

⏳ Temporal Drift – When things get too hot, activate the Temporal Drift! Slow down time to give yourself the edge in tight situations, allowing you to dodge incoming attacks, navigate tricky corners, or take out hordes of monsters in slow motion. Master the flow of time to survive the chaos.

🌆 Dynamic City – A sprawling world of dense city streets, rugged mountains, and scorching deserts. Drift through chaos, blaze across shifting terrain, and take insane shortcuts to outmaneuver both monsters and rival delivery drivers.

🏍 Eject & Escape – When fully upgraded, your car isn’t your only ride. In desperate situations, eject with a high-speed motorcycle and weave through the chaos to survive another day.

🔥 Environmental Tactics – Use the city itself as a weapon. Freeze or electrify puddles, set trash piles ablaze, and trigger chain reactions to turn the tide against the monstrous hordes.

🔥Style & Speed Matter – Drifting isn’t just about getting from A to B. Chain monster kills to boost your EXP multiplier, extend drift length to amplify your damage, and pull off near-miss stunts for maximum style points. Drifting also charges certain upgrades, turning every turn into a tactical decision. More style means bigger rewards, better upgrades, and ultimate bragging rights.

⏰ Dynamic Time and Weather – Experience a living, breathing city with a fully dynamic day-night cycle and ever-changing weather conditions. From stormy nights to sunny days, each shift affects gameplay and adds to the challenge as you drift through the ruined streets.

🦠 Evolving Infestation – The monstrous infection spreads with each passing day, mutating the city and its creatures. Delay the inevitable or dive into the chaos—adapt fast, or be consumed.

💀 The Ultimate Mission – Beyond survival and deliveries, your true purpose is to find a way to wipe out the monsters forever and stop the interdimensional invasion at its source.

CAN YOU DELIVER IN HELL?

The roads are deadly. The monsters are relentless. Only the fastest, most fearless drifters will survive, and save our world.
